description: This Java source file defines the `SeoContextFilter` class, which implements the `jakarta.servlet.Filter` interface. It manages access restrictions for certain URL paths and configures request forwarding and error handling related to SEO and web application context filtering. The filter inspects incoming HTTP requests, applies path restrictions, forwards requests based on URL patterns, and handles error or redirect responses accordingly.

classes.name: SeoContextFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that restricts access to certain URL paths, manages forwarding based on URL patterns, and handles error and redirect responses in a web application context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters, collecting allowed paths and registered servlets.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filter method that inspects incoming requests, applies restrictions, possibly forwards requests, or sends error/redirect responses based on configured rules.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is taken out of service (empty implementation).

methods.name: forwardUri
methods.description: Checks if a given URI matches predefined patterns for forwarding and, if so, modifies the response to redirect accordingly.
